purpose: Prioritized remaining work required to move the AFAGH Virtual Office architecture from current evidence state to a green final gate.

items.title: Green Architecture Gate
items.why: Final release cannot proceed while the shared architecture gate is not green.
items.exit: Latest architecture gate passes all required stages on the release head.

items.title: Verify host-level branch protection
items.why: Repository policy exists but host-level branch protection was not independently verifiable.
items.exit: Branch protection/rules are machine-verifiably enabled on the protected branch.

items.title: Canonical CRM evidence
items.why: CRM foundations and command path exist, but production-grade canonical customer/business evidence is not yet proven.
items.exit: End-to-end CRM journey produces verifiable customer/business evidence from the approved source.

items.title: Production provider evidence
items.why: Production Intelligence is implemented, but real provider connectivity and production evidence remain unproven.
items.exit: Provider registry, health, breaker, failover and evidence are verified against approved production-like providers.

items.title: Real provider connectivity
items.why: Provider registry/health/circuit-breaker foundations exist, but connectivity remains a release dependency.
items.exit: Approved provider connectivity passes health, timeout, degradation and recovery verification.

items.title: Production transaction proof
items.why: Operation runner/recovery exists, but release-grade end-to-end transaction evidence is still required.
items.exit: A representative consequential journey proves policy, approval, execute, verify, audit and recovery end-to-end.

items.title: Production security evidence
items.why: Secret boundary and failure injection exist, but production security evidence and host controls remain incomplete.
items.exit: Security verification proves fail-closed behavior, secret-reference boundary and approved host controls.

items.title: Authorization evidence
items.why: Identity propagation is implemented, but production authorization outcomes need durable evidence.
items.exit: Representative authorization decisions are verified and traceable through the runtime.

items.title: Production business journeys + KPI linkage
items.why: Business journeys and acceptance criteria exist, but live operational KPIs are not connected to execution evidence.
items.exit: Representative business journeys execute with measurable KPI evidence and acceptance verification.

items.title: Production event infrastructure evidence
items.why: Trace/audit foundations exist, but production event infrastructure still needs direct evidence.
items.exit: Production event path demonstrates traceable propagation, audit provenance and recovery linkage.

items.title: Live SLI stream + validated cost telemetry
items.why: SLI/SLO and cost governor foundations exist, but live telemetry is not yet validated.
items.exit: Live latency/availability/reliability/cost signals are captured, validated and bound to guardrails.

items.title: Formal four-team release approval
items.why: The four-team process exists, but release approval depends on green evidence across all gates.
items.exit: Teams 1-4 each record PASS against the same release head and evidence bundle.

items.title: Production infrastructure verification depth
items.why: Runtime foundations need broader environment-level verification beyond core provider controls.
items.exit: Approved runtime topology, dependency health and degradation behavior are verified in a production-like environment.

items.title: Operational KPI instrumentation
items.why: Operational business metrics need durable instrumentation after production journey proof.
items.exit: Core operating KPIs are emitted with trace/evidence linkage and reviewed by Product/Business.
